message:
Running command: cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul
INC="-Iinclude -Ibuild/host/include -Imrbgems/mruby-time/include -Imrbgems/mruby-io/include"
CFLAGS="-std=gnu99 -O1 -g -fsanitize=address -fno-omit-frame-pointer -DMRB_USE_RATIONAL -DMRB_USE_COMPLEX"
count=0; fail=0
# gem src files
for c in $(find mrbgems -path "*/src/*.c" -not -path "*/mruby-compiler/*"); do
  base=$(echo "$c" | sed 's|/|_|g;s|\.c$||')
  if gcc $CFLAGS $INC -c "$c" -o "/tmp/mrbobj/${base}.o" 2>/tmp/err.txt; then count=$((count+1)); else fail=$((fail+1)); echo "FAIL: $c"; head -3 /tmp/err.txt; fi
done
echo "gem src: compiled=$count failed=$fail"

message.content: Now let me compile all the gem source files and gem_init files.
